meta.what: Human-authorable assessment banks — the question half of the schema.
meta.why: Authored per story. build_story_items.py derives ids, flags and counts.
meta.review_flag: _draft: true means model-drafted and NOT yet reviewed.
rules: measurement: MCQ, band-INVARIANT — write it answerable from the YOUNGER band's text.
measurement rows: [skill, prompt, [options], correct_index, difficulty_prior, suitable_from_age]
measurement skill must be C* with prior>0; >=2 unique options; correct index in range.
discussion: band-SPECIFIC, never scored. rows: [skill, band, prompt]
discussion skill must be M* with prior>0; M5 is 9+ only; requires_adult is derived, never authored.
a story needs a prompt for each band a child could actually READ it in.
